errors.triggerRequired: The trigger needs at least one letter or number.
errors.duplicate: A snippet with the trigger “{{trigger}}” already exists.

help.title: How snippets work
help.body: A snippet is a shortcut for text you type a lot. Give it a trigger phrase and the text it stands for. Whenever you say that phrase while dictating, Voxflow types the saved text instead. Triggers aren’t case-sensitive, and the text can be as long as you like, including several lines. You can also type something you’ve copied, such as a link, by saying “this link” (to add a link you copied) or “paste link” (to type any copied text).
help.example: Add the trigger “my address” with the text “221B Baker Street, London”. Then say “send it to my address” and Voxflow types “send it to 221B Baker Street, London”.

clipboard.title: Insert what you copied
clipboard.description: Copy a link, then say “check out this link” and Voxflow adds it after the words. Or say “paste link” to type whatever text you copied.

toggle.label: Paste by voice (any copied text)
toggle.description: Say a paste phrase and Voxflow types the text you last copied in its place. Voxflow only looks at your clipboard when you say one.

phrases.label: Phrases that paste it
phrases.description: Say any of these. Pick wording you wouldn’t say otherwise. “Past” is included because speech models sometimes write “paste” that way.
phrases.placeholder: Add a phrase, such as “paste video”
phrases.error: The phrase needs at least one letter or number.

toggle.label: Add a copied link after “this link”
toggle.description: When you say “this link”, “the link” or similar and your clipboard holds a web address, Voxflow adds that address right after the words. It only does this for a single web address.

phrases.label: Phrases that add the link
phrases.description: Say one of these and the copied link follows it. “Check out this link” becomes “Check out this link https://…”.
phrases.placeholder: Add a phrase, such as “this recipe”

dictionary.title: Your dictionary
dictionary.description: Words help Voxflow spell names and terms right. Replacements swap one phrase for another after transcribing.
dictionary.empty: Nothing here yet. Add a word, or a word with what to replace it with.

errors.required: Enter a word with at least one letter or number.

help.title: How the dictionary works
help.body: Use a word when Voxflow keeps getting a name or term wrong, such as a person, a product or a technical word: type it, leave “Replace with” empty, and press Add. Use a replacement to swap what Voxflow writes for something else: type the phrase, then what it should become. Replacements apply to everything you dictate.
help.example: Word: “Voxflow”, so it’s spelled right every time. Replacement: “gonna” becomes “going to”, so “I’m gonna go” is typed as “I’m going to go”.

styles.title: Writing style
styles.description: How Voxflow writes what you say. This is the style for every app without its own.

formal.name: Formal
formal.description: Complete sentences with capital letters and a closing full stop.

casual.name: Casual
casual.description: Exactly as transcribed, with natural punctuation.

veryCasual.name: Very casual
veryCasual.description: Lowercase sentence starts and no final full stop.

technical.name: Technical
technical.description: Keeps your capitalisation, no final full stop. Good for code and commands.

apps.title: Per-app styles
apps.description: Voxflow checks which app you’re typing into and uses its style.
apps.empty: No apps yet. Add the apps where you want a different style.

help.title: How writing styles work
help.body: A style changes how Voxflow writes what you said: capital letters, final full stops and so on. It all happens on your computer. Pick the default style for everyone, then add apps that should use a different one. Voxflow checks which app you’re typing into when you finish speaking.
help.example: Set Messages to Very casual and Mail to Formal. The same sentence is typed as “see you at noon” in Messages and “See you at noon.” in Mail.

help.title: Meeting mode
help.example: Start before a call, stop when it ends
help.body: Records your microphone and the sound playing on this Mac, so the other people on a call are included. When you stop, the meeting is transcribed on this computer and added to History. Nothing is uploaded.

meetings.ready: Start before your call begins. Voxflow records you and everyone you hear.
meetings.micOnly: Only your microphone is being recorded. Allow system audio recording for Voxflow in System Settings → Privacy & Security to include the other people on the call.
meetings.saved: Meeting saved. Transcribing it now; it will appear in History.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Flytbare installationer kan ikke opdateres automatisk. Download installeren til dit system nedenfor, kør den, og installer i den samme mappe — din Data/-mappe (indstillinger, modeller, optagelser) bliver bevaret.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Flytbare installationer kan ikke opdateres automatisk. Download den nyeste version til dit system fra GitHub Releases, og installer den i den samme mappe — din Data/-mappe (indstillinger, modeller, optagelser) bliver bevaret.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Mikrofonadgang blev nægtet af operativsystemet. Giv venligst mikrofontilladelse i dine systemindstillinger.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Aktivér mikrofonadgang under Indstillinger → Privatliv og sikkerhed → Mikrofon (inklusive adgang for skrivebordsapps).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Giv mikrofonadgang under Systemindstillinger → Privatliv og sikkerhed → Mikrofon.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Giv mikrofonadgang i dit systems lyd- eller privatlivsindstillinger.

errors.noInputDevice: Ingen lydinputenhed blev registreret. Tilslut en mikrofon eller et headset, og prøv igen.
errors.pasteFailed: Teksten kunne ikke indsættes i det aktive program.

theme.title: Applikationstema
theme.description: Vælg om Voxflow skal følge dit systemtema eller forblive lyst eller mørkt

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS blokerer midlertidigt ændringer af genveje
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Genveje kan ikke optages lige nu — macOS Secure Input blokerer tastehændelser. Løs advarslen om Secure Input først.
